data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'Xavrios' meaning 'Graceful', 'Bearer of God'. In Christian tradition, Xavrian signifies the grace and favor of God. The name Xavrian carries the meaning “Graceful bearer of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Xavrian usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful bearer of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Xavrian total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: זאבריאן
in_hebrew.meaning: נגזר משם עברי ש означает 'אלוהים הוא החיים' או 'אלוהים הוא האור'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם זאבריאן מקורו בשם עברי שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא החיים' או 'אלוהים הוא האור'. השם נגזר מהמילים 'חוה' שפירושו 'חיים' ו'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. הוא משמש לעתים קרובות בקהילות נוצריות כהבעת הערצה לאלוהים ולחיים הנצחיים.

in_greek.name: Ξαβριάν
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα προέρχεται από το Εβραϊκό και σημαίνει 'ο Θεός είναι ζωή' ή 'ο Θεός είναι φως'
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ξαβριάν έχει τις ρίζες του στην Εβραϊκή γλώσσα και συγκεκριμένα από τις λέξεις 'חוה' (Chavah) που σημαίνει 'ζωή' και 'אל' (El) που σημαίνει 'Θεός'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόλο που δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, το όνομα αντανακλά την πνευματική σημασία της σύνδεσης με τον Θεό και την αιώνια ζωή. Η χρήση του ονόματος αυτού ήταν σημαντική στην παλιά Εκκλησία ως σύμβολο πίστης και αφοσίωσης.

This name is not directly mentioned in the Bible but reflects a profound spiritual significance in Christian tradition. It symbolizes a deep connection to God and eternal life. Historically, names with similar etymologies have been used in Christian communities to express devotion and faith. The name Xavrian is associated with positive personality traits such as spiritual depth and a strong connection to one's faith.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Xavrian is a name of celestial grace, evoking images of St. Francis Xavier's boundless love and missionary zeal. It symbolizes a deep connection with God, a fierce commitment to spread His word, and a compassionate heart that touches and transforms lives.

historical_references.reference: According to legend, Saint Xavier was born in 1500 in Galicia, Spain, and was educated in the Dominican order. He later served as a missionary to the New World, primarily in what is now Mexico and South America. The name 'Xavrian' may have derived from his given name, Francis Xavier.

Saint Xavier is also known for founding the Society of Jesus, or the Jesuits, in 1540. The name 'Xavrian' may have also been associated with this religious order due to its connection with Saint Xavier.
